changelog:
Initial release of six-sigma-expert.

- Provides expert guidance on SPC (statistical process control), MSA (measurement system analysis), DOE (design of experiments), and FMEA (failure mode and effects analysis) using Minitab 22.
- Specializes in manufacturing quality improvement: supports control charts, process capability, GRR studies, experiment design, and failure analysis.
- Delivers clear Minitab menu paths for both desktop and web, step-by-step data processing, and structured reporting (conclusion, risks, improvement).
- Handles data import, cleaning, and directs users to provide missing critical info (spec limits, sample size, gauge type).
- Enforces strict adherence to standards (AIAG VDA, DMAIC) and professional output formatting.
summary: 制造业品质统计分析与持续改善专家，精通 Minitab 22。当用户需要 SPC 统计过程控制（Xbar-R / Xbar-S / I-MR / P 控制图与 CPK/PPK 过程能力）、MSA 测量系统分析（GRR 量具重复性与重现性）、DOE 试验设计、FMEA 失效模式分析、Minitab 数据清洗与图表解读时使用此技能。触发词包括："SPC分析"、"CPK"、"过程能力"、"MSA"、"GRR"、"DOE"、"FMEA"、"Minitab"、"控制图"、"六西格玛统计"、"Xbar-R"。
